info.title: Fenergo Nebula Doc Gen Query
info.description:
**Doc Gen Query API**:
Doc Gen Query API retrieves Document Generation configurations.
**Doc Gen Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query for Document Generation configurations. That includes searching a document template by ID.

get.summary: Render a preview of a custom template version using mock data
get.description:
Renders the template version to HTML using mock data (5 rows for loops/tables), returned as a JSON string for an editor-side preview. Any failure yields an HTML error page with a 200 status, so the caller can always display the response. No PDF or document is produced.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: DocGenConfigurationAccess

parameters.name: setId
parameters.description: The Id of the custom template set

parameters.name: versionNumber
parameters.description: The version number to preview

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

200.description: The rendered preview HTML (or an HTML error page if rendering failed)

401.description: User is not authorized to perform this request

messages.message: Access denied. Following permissions are required: Permission1, Permission2
